name: ParseTextNode
label: Parse Text
description: Parses a text to find the first or all occurrences of a specified subtext or regular expression pattern.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: TextToParse
fields.label: Text To Parse
fields.description: The text value that will be parsed based on the specified search pattern.

fields.name: SearchPattern
fields.label: Search Pattern
fields.description: The subtext or regular expression pattern to search for.

fields.name: IsRegularExpression
fields.label: Is Regular Expression
fields.description: If true, treats 'Search Pattern' as a regular expression pattern.

fields.name: StartPosition
fields.label: Start Parsing At Position
fields.description: The index at which to start parsing the text.

fields.name: FirstOccurrenceOnly
fields.label: First Occurrence Only
fields.description: If true, returns only the first occurrence of the search pattern.

fields.name: IgnoreCase
fields.label: Ignore Case
fields.description: If true, performs a case-insensitive search.

fields.name: ParsedMatches
fields.label: Parsed Matches
fields.description: Returns the list of matches found in the text.
